data.name: Flori
data.gender_notes: Flori is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘flos’, meaning flower. In ancient Rome, the name was given to a child born during the flowering season. This name represents new beginnings, growth, and beauty. The name Flori carries the meaning “Flowering, blooming” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Flori usually hope their child will grow to embody flowering, blooming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of new life and renewal in Christ.
data.etymology: Flori belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flowering, blooming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Flori total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: פלורי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם פלורי נגזר מהמילה העברית 'פרח', שפירושה לצמוח, לשגשג ולהתפתח. הוא קשור לנושאים של צמיחה רוחנית ופריחה, ומשמש כסמל לתקווה וחדשנות בחיי הנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Φλώρι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φλώρι προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'άνθος', που σημαίνει λουλούδι ή άνθιση. Στην παράδοση των πρώτων Χριστιανών, το όνομα συνδέεται με την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την άνθιση της πίστης, συμβολίζοντας την ανανέωση και την αιώνια ζωή.

in_latin.name: Flori
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Flori derivatur a latino 'flos, floris', significans florem seu crescentiam. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc indicat incrementum spirituale et floritionem fidei, exprimens spem et vitam aeternam.

in_english.name: Flori
in_english.long_meaning: The name Flori originates from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying growth, blooming, and flourishing. It symbolizes spiritual development and renewal in Christian tradition, reflecting hope and eternal life. Historically, the name has been associated with the concepts of new beginnings and spiritual awakening.

data.cultural_impact: The name “Flori” represents the blossoming of new life and beauty, making it a popular choice for Christian girls. Naming a child “Flori” highlights the importance of renewal and new beginnings, reflecting the biblical themes of growth and rebirth.
data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name “Flori” carries a deeper spiritual meaning. It symbolizes the regeneration and sanctification of the soul, as one grows closer to God. The name also reflects Christ's dying and rising from the dead, as described in the Easter story, ultimately representing the hope and renewal found through faith.
